set.body:
Outcome

Freeze the replacement contract and the evidence that must survive before implementation changes begin.

Acceptance

- Architecture constitution records the one-ontology end state, ownership boundaries, anti-goals, and deletion policy.
- Existing numerical fixtures and focused JVM/Scala.js results are inventoried.
- The noncanonical sample-identity defect has an executable regression.
- No new cases are added to RoiPayload, Response, FoldPlan, or FeatureSetKind.
- This gate closes only after all Phase 0 children close.
set.title: P0: ratify the clean-break MVPA constitution and baseline
